players.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
players.summary: Ryan Jeffers on IL-60 after hamate bone surgery May 19. Expected to miss 6-8 weeks from surgery date.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: 4-for-5 with HR, 2 RBI, 2 runs as Cubs win at St. Louis. Batting .237 on the season.

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice goes 4-for-5 with HR, 2 doubles, 2 RBI, 2R as Yankees win their 5th straight. Batting .239 on the season.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Teoscar Hernandez placed on IL-10 with Grade 1 left hamstring strain suffered May 27. Expected ~4-week absence.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Cole Ragans remains on IL-15 with elbow impingement. Rehab start canceled after elbow stiffness returned. Return timeline uncertain.
